context.label: Nations, covenant, and royal limits

observations.body: Israel is addressed as treasured possession, kingdom of priests, and holy nation before the covenant words are spoken.
observations.label: A kingdom of priests at Sinai

observations.body: The passage places Kingdom people beside a kingdom of priests at sinai.
observations.label: Kingdom people

payload.posture: Read Exodus 19:4–8 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states israel is addressed as treasured possession, kingdom of priests, and holy nation before the covenant words are spoken. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
payload.title: A kingdom of priests at Sinai
